decisions.VA01: Preserve VAL-PRIMARY weight 8, VAL-RET weight 8, VAL-MOS weight 4, and all canonical bands.
decisions.VA02: Do not substitute qualitative profiles for quantitative valuation.
decisions.VA03: Prioritize Method B detailed sector valuation. Use Method A bounded analyst valuation when detailed evidence is insufficient.
decisions.VA04: Method A retains canonical valuation band semantics.
decisions.VA05: Method A ceilings: PRIMARY 6/8, RET 6/8, MOS 3/4.
decisions.VA06: Apply sector-specific valuation methods. DCF is not mandatory for every VN30 issuer.
decisions.VA07: For FPT, prioritize DCF/SOTP, with normalized earnings valuation and bounded owner-earnings valuation as fallback.
decisions.VA08: Use raw close at cutoff, not adjusted close. Verify units and source hash.
decisions.VA09: Verify shares outstanding and corporate-action basis at the same cutoff.
decisions.VA10: Permit qualified normalized earnings ranges rather than requiring an exact point estimate.
decisions.VA11: Annualized NPAT is not automatically normalized earnings. Require scope and materiality review.
decisions.VA12: Preserve FTEL accounting scope and economic exposure. Do not mechanically combine pre-FTEL and post-FTEL observations.
decisions.VA13: Distinguish Cost of Equity, WACC, Expected IRR and investor hurdle rate.
decisions.VA14: Permit economically supported analyst cost-of-capital ranges.
decisions.VA15: Implement Valuation Assumption Qualification Framework. Sensitivity-only inputs cannot independently authorize scoring.
decisions.VA16: Use base, downside, upside and reverse valuation. A qualified explicitly conservative base case does not require scenario probabilities.
decisions.VA18: VAL-RET must address growth, exit value, distributions, dilution and scenario uncertainty.
decisions.VA19: Evaluate no-multiple-expansion returns separately. Do not award high points merely because of rerating.
decisions.VA20: VAL-MOS requires conservative intrinsic value, downside and permanent impairment review.
decisions.VA21: Do not automatically equate consolidated FCF with parent-shareholder FCFE or classify all deposits as excess cash.
decisions.VA22: Preserve valuation cross-checks and common-dependency controls. Do not mechanically average conflicting models.
decisions.VA23: Reuse confidence, counterevidence, materiality and Incremental Assessment.
decisions.VA24: Qualified valuation models may be retained, but price-sensitive points must be recalculated using the new raw price and current share basis. Do not mechanically carry forward valuation scores.
decisions.VA25: Preserve Risk Policy, Stage 0, Hard Veto, formal ranking, actionability and production authority.
decisions.VA26: Use retained FY2022–FY2025 and Q1–Q3/2026 evidence through 2026-11-13. Do not reopen WP1–WP4.
decisions.VA27: Update the six existing skills and execute actual cumulative Prepare → Adoption → Preflight → Scoring for BQ + FH + GQ + IC + VAL.
decisions.VA28: Complete one coordinated implementation and assumption-qualification cycle using retained evidence. Do not force points or repeat evidence discovery. Genuine N/R is acceptable.
